profile.headline: FedRAMP 20x Moderate Authorized, Software Engineer @ Paramify

positions.title: Co-Founder, Founding Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered an innovative full-stack application that revolutionized data entry for sales representatives by integrating Zoom Marketplace and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) apps with HubSpot CRM, utilizing OpenAI API for intelligent data generation.

● Spearheaded the development of a user-friendly front end using React and implemented robust backend services with Express.js and Python/Flask.
● Implemented secure user authentication by integrating Google Firebase, enhancing system integrity and user trust.
● Masterfully orchestrated AWS DevOps workflows, setup of Pipelines CI/CD, management of EC2 instances, deployment on Beanstalk, and efficient use of S3 and Cloudfront, with a MySQL database hosted on RDS for scalable storage solutions.
● Directed customer success initiatives and technical support operations, successfully aggregating critical user feedback for product enhancements and rapid bug resolution.
positions.insights: Skills: AWS Elastic Beanstalk · JavaScript · Programming Languages · Express.js · MySQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Flask · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon S3 · Ant Design · Amazon EC2 · Node.js · Sequelize.js · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Programming · Computer Science · GraphQL · Firebase · Amazon CloudFront · Web Development · Technical Requirements · REST APIs · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · React.js

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.description:
Championed the development of a robust cryptocurrency marketplace platform, facilitating user search, market insights, and seamless token-exchanging capabilities.

● Innovated a data visualization tool using AirBnB's Visx library, enabling users to conduct comprehensive token analysis and make informed investment decisions.
● Constructed and maintained a scalable company database utilizing MongoDB, with streamlined CRUD operations through Mongoose ORM, significantly enhancing data management efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Programming Languages · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MongoDB · Amazon S3 · Node.js · Programming · Computer Science · Web Development · Technical Requirements · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: South Jordan, Utah, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Led the creation of smart contracts for NFT initiatives utilizing Solidity and the OpenZeppelin library, coupled with crafting marketing websites in React to support ERC-721 token transactions via MetaMask wallets.

● Developed and deployed secure, reliable smart contracts for NFT acquisitions, advancing digital asset ownership.
● Engineered responsive marketing platforms in React to facilitate user interaction and token purchases, enhancing customer experience and engagement.
● Pioneered the use of InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) for decentralized hosting, ensuring robust data integrity and access within the blockchain ecosystem.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Programming Languages · Amazon S3 · Node.js · Programming · Computer Science · Web Development · React.js

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and integrated an advanced e-commerce solution, leveraging Shopify’s GraphQL API and WooCommerce’s REST API, with Node.js backend development, and established intuitive user interfaces using React/Material UI, enabling clients to effortlessly create discount offerings for an extensive network of over 84,000 influencers.

● Revolutionized client engagements by automating the Whitelabel onboarding process, delivering a significant time saving of 11 hours per week for the team, thereby enhancing operational efficiency and productivity
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Programming Languages · Amazon CloudWatch · MySQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · E-Commerce · Material-UI · Amazon S3 · Amazon EC2 · Node.js · Sequelize.js · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Programming · Computer Science · GraphQL · Web Development · Technical Requirements · REST APIs · React.js

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description:
Conducted an in-depth analysis of over 405,000 data entries to identify and assess discrepancies, offering strategic insights on quarterly fluctuations affecting client net asset values, return on investments, and internal rates of return.

● Played a pivotal role in the management of client reporting for portfolios totaling $10 billion, ensuring accuracy and integrity in high-stakes financial data presentation.
